issues.description: The template Person entity uses the field name 'firstName' to represent a person's given name, while the solution Person entity declares this attribute as 'forename'. This is a direct identifier mismatch for the same conceptual property (the person's first/given name). The inconsistency is visible because other code (getters/setters and tests) in the solution still reference 'firstName' while the field is declared as 'forename', increasing confusion and likely causing compilation/runtime errors. Students reading the problem/template expect and use 'firstName' but the solution repository introduces a different identifier for the same concept.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the identifier consistent across artifacts. Rename the field 'forename' in solution_repository/src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java to 'firstName' (and update any internal references) so it matches the template, getters/setters, and tests. Alternatively (less recommended), update all uses of 'firstName' (getters/setters/tests) to consistently use 'forename' across template, tests, and documentation — but the simpler fix is to align the solution field name to 'firstName'.
